messages:
alex: heads up — vendor just pushed a freight uplift and wants to swap 6 units from our Q2 allocation to a pilot lane. new ETA slipped 4 days. forwarding their note + ask: can we accept pilot swap and cover uplift, or keep original allocation?

vendor-liaison: we got official from FastFreight: +USD 1,200 per AWB for air uplift (customs cleared). they can air-expedite 6 H100s to FRA pool, but requires serial-level swap and RMA pre-labeling. their quote: AWB TT123456789 / uplift fee 7200 USD total.

mira: can you post the AWB & serials? need to confirm depot acceptance and customs HS code mapping.

vendor-liaison: AWB and serials below (they attached manifest):

```
AWB: TT123456789
Serials: H100-AX12, H100-AX13, H100-AX14, H100-AX15, H100-AX16, H100-AX17
Destination: FRA-DEPOT-3
Customs HS: 8471.70
```

jeff: if we accept, estimate incremental monthly cost impact ~ $8k (uplift + brokerages). throughput improves but burn vs waiting depends on backlog. what is current queued demand?

alex: queued demand is high — we have two Dedicated customers and 3 internal trials waiting. if pilot lane ships earlier we free up staging and reduce preflight rework.

anna-ops: RMA side: vendor requires RMA pre-labeling for serial swap. we need to create return labels for the swap units and ensure depot can process immediate putaway. i can spin a temp RMA batch if we approve. @paul can you sign off on cross-dock tariff?

paul: quick check — the uplift changes CN (commercial number) which might affect our reclaim VAT flow. okay to proceed if finance ok with provisional invoice. pinging finance separately.

ops-bot: tracking update: current allocation pool for FRA=12 H100s, reserved=8, available=4. swaps would reduce available to -2 (net short) unless we reallocate from US pool.

mira: we cannot leave pool negative. options: a) accept pilot + pull 2 from US spare (lead time 3d) b) refuse pilot and keep Q2 allocation c) accept but vendor holds 2 until next wave (no uplift for those).

vendor-liaison: vendor offers compromise: air 6 now (uplift applies to all 6) OR air 4 now + 2 sea (no uplift) — sea ETA +12 days. they need decision by EOD CET.

jeff: preference = 4 air + 2 sea. minimizes cost and reduces negative pool hit. we still shorten pressure for high-priority requests.

alex: agree. anna-ops, start RMA pre-label flow for 4 serials. vendor-liaison confirm AWB for 4 and sea booking for 2. include provisional invoice and broker contact.

anna-ops: starting RMA batch now. labels template:
```
RMA-BATCH: RB-2026-034
SERIALS: H100-AX12,H100-AX13,H100-AX14,H100-AX15
ACTION: outbound exchange, return label + depot pre-ack
```

vendor-liaison: confirming — will send AWB TT123456789 modified to 4 units and sea booking reference SB998877 for 2 units. uplift invoice coming in 30 min.

shipping-bot: note: if we route 2 from US pool, add cross-region transfer ETA 72h and transit insurance +$300.

paul: finance greenlight conditional on provisional invoice and VAT reconciliation. if invoice arrives I'll sign off.

alex: great. final action items: vendor-liaison accept 4-air/2-sea compromise; anna-ops create RMA labels & notify FRA depot; jeff/paul confirm cost split and transfer if needed. i'll update the Dedicated customers. :thumbsup:

vendor-liaison: will update here once AWB + invoice posted. thanks everyone.
